results.summary_before: This design implements an SPI peripheral with eight read/write 8-bit registers and eight read-only 8-bit status registers, derived from the tt07_alu_74181 project. It is tested by connecting an RP2040 SPI master to the SPI pins and using MicroPython code to write and read registers, with the first register also driving a 7-segment display. The design improves on the original by using a single buffer counter and adding high-impedance control for MISO when chip select is high. No external hardware is required beyond the RP2040 and the 7-segment display.

results.summary_before: This Verilog project uses stochastic computing to implement an integrator based on Euler's definition of integration in the unipolar probability domain. Two serial input pins accept stochastic bit streams, and eight output pins expose several sequential, system and test integrator outputs. The suggested test is to hold one input high and the other low and observe the resulting equations on the outputs. An ADALM2000 is listed as the external hardware, and the documentation gives only a brief description of the internal structure.
